stories.headline: CFPB Deletes Thousands of Webpages Amid Agency Remake
stories.body: The Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) deleted at least 2,200 pages from its website in May, The Guardian reported Thursday (June 4). The content that was removed includes press releases, consumer advisories, congressional testimonies, speeches and blog posts, all of which was published before President Donald Trump’s second term, according to the report. stories.headline: Truist taps ex-BofA executive Cathy Bessant to serve on board
stories.body: Cathy Bessant, who was Bank of America's vice chair of global strategy when she retired, is joining Truist's board of directors and will sit on the company's risk committee. Bessant was American Banker's Most Powerful Woman in Banking for three consecutive years.
